title: Civilian shot in Shaki; Armenian authorities report a serviceman detained
summary: Hetq reports that Armenia’s National Security Service said a civilian was shot in the leg in Shaki, Syunik Province, on October 1. Armenian authorities detained an Azerbaijani serviceman whom they identified as the alleged attacker and opened criminal proceedings. The report does not establish an ongoing attack or wider armed conflict. The date is known; the exact shooting time is not established.
